body:
From text generation to image creation, AI tools are being used to automate and streamline a wide range of business tasks and processes.

For example, check out my other article where I describe how to use ChatGPT for brand strategy development (naming, marketing, SEO, etc.)

Also, in another article, I show you how to use Midjourney for logo design.

However, there are plenty of AI tools (with new ones coming up every day)—so I picked the best ones and categorized them for you.

Here's my list of currently the best AI tools for every business need—sorted by category.

100+ Best AI Tools For Every Business:

  1. AI Chatbots—ChatGPT, BingChat, Claude, Google Bard, Perplexity, Poe
  2. AI Article Writers—Jasper, CopyAI, WordTune, NotionAI, TextCortex, Quillbot
  3. AI Plagiarism Checkers—OriginalityAI, CopyLeaks, GTP Radar, Passed.AI, Grammarly
  4. AI Image Generators—Midjourney, DALL-E, Adobe Firefly, Ideogram, LeonardoAI, illustroke
  5. AI Image Editors—Prome AI, ClipDrop, Luminar, Topaz Labs, Microsoft Designer, Exactly AI
  6. AI Marketing Tools—AdCreative, Adobe Express, Canva, CreativeFlow, Baseline, PicFlow
  7. AI Website Builders—Relume AI, Framer AI, Wix ADI, 10Web, Mixo, UIzard
  8. AI Video Generators—Runway, FlexClip, Flicki, WiseCut, Invideo, Pictory
  9. AI Video Editors—Descript, Wise Cuts, RiverSide, Repurpose, Gling, TimeBolt
  10. AI Avatar Creators— HeyGen, Synthesia, BHuman, Movavi, D-ID, DeepBrain AI
  11. AI Voice Cloning—ElevenLabs, Playht, Resemble AI, Murf AI, Adobe Podcast
  12. AI Productivity App—Taskade, MyAskAI, Genei, Mem, Otter, Reclaim
  13. AI Music Generation—Mubert, Soundraw, Lalal AI, Beatoven AI
  14. AI SEO Tools—SurferSEO, SEOmatic, AIOSEO, Scalenut
  15. AI Presentation Tools—Alai,Tome, BeautifulAI, Gamma, Typeset

Most of these tools are freemium, which means they come with basic features for free, but you can also get a premium subscription for access to better features, faster response time, more quota, etc.

Let's start with AI chatbots and text-generation tools, as they can be used for a variety of business tasks.

1. AI Chatbots

Text-generation AI tools, also known as chatbots, are designed to produce written content automatically.

These types of tools leverage artificial intelligence, think about all of that data that they were fed with—websites, books, podcasts, videos, etc.

It can help you save time with your daily activities as you don't have to do boring, mundane tasks like research, brainstorming, copywriting, etc.

Best AI Chatbots:

  1. ‍ChatGPT is the most popular of all (the first big one). It’s a very capable tool that can generate high-quality content in natural language.‍
  2. Bing is like a version of ChatGPT from Microsoft, that can basically do the same as ChatGPT does (It runs on GPT4).‍
  3. NotionAI is an extension of the Notion App, the popular tool that many creatives and business people use for task management, note-taking, etc.—Now, you can also generate text right inside the app!
  4. ‍Google Bard: Experimental conversational AI from Google to take on ChatGPT. Still in early stages.
  5. ‍Perplexity: Content generation help for creators/marketers. Optimized for business use cases.
  6. ‍Poe: Prioritizes safety, accuracy and transparency. Specializes in nuanced, scientifically grounded responses.

Chatbots can generally help you be more creative and efficient at your work.

2. AI Article Writers

AI article writers are text-generation tools designed to assist with creating written content specifically.

They often run on GPT4 or other LLM but are optimized for content production (workflows, templates, started prompts etc.)

These tools excel at outlining, paraphrasing, summarizing, and providing SEO and grammar recommendations.

They augment rather than replace human writing by collaborating seamlessly in the content creation workflow.

Top AI Article Writers:

  • Jasper - Generates SEO-focused article ideas and outlines based on top-ranking web pages. Integrates with Google Workspace.
  • ‍CopyAI—Optimized specifically for blogging and SEO content. Provides outlines and intro paragraphs.
  • ‍WordTune—Robust grammar, vocabulary and style editor to refine draft posts. Advanced corrections.
  • ‍NotionAI—Writing assistant built specifically inside the Notion productivity app. Drafts content.
  • ‍TextCortex—Analyzes text and makes optimization suggestions tailored to readability, engagement and search visibility.
  • ‍Quillbot—Paraphrasing tool for rewriting existing text by altering word choice and sentence structure while preserving meaning.

BTW. Also check out Originality AI to make sure that your content unique and free of plagiarism.

3. AI Plagiarism Checkers

AI plagiarism checkers employ artificial intelligence to scan written content for duplicated or copied text from other online sources.

They help content creators and students ensure originality and avoid plagiarism issues.

Key capabilities provided by leading AI plagiarism checking tools include identifying passages copied from the web, paraphrasing suggestions to maintain integrity, and detailed similarity reports. Some also check for improper citations.

Top AI Plagiarism Checkers

  • OriginalityAI - Powerful plagiarism detection integrating directly into Google Docs for convenience.
  • CopyLeaks - Robust similarity checker providing plagiarism risk percentages and comparison reports.
  • GTP Radar - Specialized tool for detecting AI-generated text from systems like ChatGPT to enforce original work.
  • Passed.AI - Plagiarism checker focused on academic integrity checking student submissions against web and its database.
  • Grammarly - In addition to its writing enhancement capabilities, Grammarly also scans for plagiarism with basic similarity detection.

By running written documents through these AI plagiarism checkers, content creators and students can identify any issues with copied work and reinforce integrity through proper attribution and paraphrasing.

4. AI Image Generators

AI image generators leverage artificial intelligence models to create original images and artworks from text descriptions.

They open new creative possibilities for artists, designers, and other creators.

Key capabilities provided by top AI art generators include photorealistic renderings, logo generations, illustrations, and more - all from natural language prompts.

Leading AI Art Generator Options

  • Midjourney - Extremely popular community-based AI art generator with a huge creative following and gallery.
  • DALL-E - Pioneering AI system from OpenAI specializing in surreal, abstract image generation capabilities.
  • Adobe Express - Integrates advanced AI image generation and editing tools for creators of all skill levels.
  • Ideogram - Focused on minimalist, customizable icon and logo generation powered by AI.
  • LeonardoAI - AI digital art studio built specifically for concept artists and illustrators.
  • Illustroke - Converts rough doodle sketches into polished illustrations via AI neural networks.

You can find many AI tools to create images these days, even companies like Shutterstock add AI image-generators to their platforms in an attempt to leverage this new technology.

5. AI Image Editors

AI image editors help you edit and enhance digital photographs and graphics (e.g. upscaling, object removal etc.)

They provide transformative tools to elevate visual content quality and impact.

Key capabilities offered by leading AI photo and image editing tools include upscaling resolution, noise reduction, object removal, adjustments (contrast, color, brightness), and automatic enhancement functions powered by neural networks.

Top AI Image Editors

  • Prome AI - Comprehensive photo editing via AI including upscaling, denoising, face editing, object removal and more.
  • ClipDrop - Viral AI design and editing app focused on removing image backgrounds in one click.
  • Luminar - Robust AI image enhancement for photographers including sky replacement, portrait editing, and layers.
  • Topaz Labs - Photo editing software leveraging AI technology to reduce image noise/blurring and amplify quality.
  • Microsoft Designer - AI-powered graphic design app assisting creators in producing social media visuals, cards, invitations.
  • Exactly AI - Web platform providing multiple AI photo editing functions like increasing resolution and correcting lens distortions.

By automating time-intensive graphic editing processes, these AI tools will enable greater efficiency and iteration speed for photographers, designers and other visual content producers.

6. AI Marketing Tools

AI marketing tools leverage artificial intelligence to streamline and enhance various marketing workflows like ad creation, design, copywriting, and more.

The key capabilities range from automated ad graphic and copy generation to data-driven recommendations.

This includes providing best practices based on goals and data analysis rather than a marketer’s intuition or manual research alone.

Top AI Tools for Marketers

  • AdCreative - AI ad maker for Facebook/Instagram generating creatives based on goals/KPIs.
  • Adobe Express - UX-driven digital design platform with AI template recommendations.
  • Canva - Massive library of AI-designed templates across social, presentations, marketing.
  • CreativeFlow - Automates UGC video clip generation for influencer marketing assets.
  • Baseline - AI copywriting focused specifically on optimizing paid social campaign text.
  • PicFlow - Camera-first app using AI to guide amateur photographers via real-time feedback.

As AI marketing capabilities progress, marketers will achieve significant lift through smarter workflows augmented by data and machine learning under the hood.

7. AI Website Builders

AI website builders can automate some of your website design and development process.

These platforms are ideal for users seeking to streamline their web design process.

They offer a range of services from layout design to content generation, enabling both novices and professionals to build visually appealing and functional websites with ease.

Top AI Website Builders:

  • Relume AI - Specializes in creating high-quality, professional-looking wireframes that you can use to build Webflow websites.
  • Framer AI - Known for its advanced AI that assists in creating interactive and responsive web designs.
  • Wix ADI - Wix's Artificial Design Intelligence tool that customizes websites based on user preferences and needs.
  • 10Web - Provides automated website setup and optimization, particularly useful for WordPress users.
  • Mixo - A newer entrant focused on blending AI with user creativity for unique website designs.
  • UIzard - Converts design mockups into code, ideal for turning visual ideas into functional websites.

8. AI Video Generators

AI video generators are cutting-edge tools that leverage artificial intelligence to create, edit, and enhance videos.

They are designed to simplify the video production process, making it accessible and efficient for both professionals and amateurs.

These tools are invaluable for those looking to produce high-quality video content with minimal effort.

They offer features like automatic editing, content generation, and visual effects, all powered by AI to ensure a seamless and creative experience.

Top AI Video Generators:

  • Runway—Offers robust AI-powered video editing and creation tools, known for its advanced features and ease of use.
  • FlexClip—A versatile tool that simplifies video making, offering a wide range of templates and customization options.‍
  • Flicki‍—Specializes in generating short, engaging video clips, ideal for social media and marketing purposes.‍
  • WiseCut—Focuses on smart editing, using AI to automatically cut and optimize video for professional results.‍
  • Invideo—A user-friendly platform that helps create videos from text content, great for presentations and explainer videos.‍
  • Pictory—Enables users to create videos from scripts, using AI to add relevant visuals and animations.

9. AI Video Editors

AI video editors are sophisticated tools that integrate artificial intelligence to enhance and streamline video editing processes.

These editors are tailored to simplify tasks like cutting, trimming, adding effects, and optimizing audio, making video production more efficient and less time-consuming.

These tools are particularly beneficial for content creators, marketers, and anyone looking to produce polished video content with ease.

They offer features like automatic transcription, smart cutting, and content repurposing, all driven by AI to ensure high-quality results with minimal manual intervention.

Top AI Video Editors:

  • Descript—Notable for its multi-functional capabilities, including transcription, editing, and overdubbing, all in one platform.
  • Wise Cuts—Specializes in intelligent editing, using AI to smartly trim and piece together video content for cohesive narratives.
  • RiverSide—Focused on podcast and video production, offering high-quality recording and automatic editing features.‍
  • Repurpose—Aims at content repurposing, converting existing videos into different formats and styles for various platforms.‍
  • Gling—Tailored for creating engaging video content, featuring AI-driven editing tools that enhance visual storytelling.‍
  • TimeBolt—Optimizes video editing time, using AI to automatically cut out silences and irrelevant parts for streamlined content.

If you have any specific aspects you'd like to delve into further, or need adjustments to this summary, please let me know. I can modify it to suit your particular requirements.

10. AI Avatar Creators

AI avatar creators are innovative tools that harness artificial intelligence to design and animate personalized avatars.

These platforms offer a wide range of customization options, allowing users to create avatars that closely resemble real humans, cartoon characters, or any desired persona.

These tools are particularly popular in areas like virtual meetings, gaming, social media, and digital marketing.

They enable users to generate unique, engaging, and interactive representations of themselves or fictional characters, enhancing digital presence and interaction.

Key AI Avatar Creators:

  • HeyGen - Specializes in generating highly realistic and customizable human-like avatars, suitable for various digital applications.
  • Synthesia - Known for creating AI-driven video avatars, often used in educational and corporate video content.
  • BHuman - Focuses on creating avatars that exhibit human-like expressions and movements, enhancing user engagement.
  • Movavi - Offers user-friendly tools for creating and animating diverse types of avatars for personal or professional use.
  • D-ID - Excels in crafting photorealistic avatars, utilizing AI to animate still photos into expressive videos.
  • DeepBrain AI - Provides AI solutions for creating lifelike avatars, often used in customer service, virtual presentations, and digital marketing.

11. AI Voice Cloning

AI voice cloning technology involves creating digital replicas of human voices using artificial intelligence.

This advanced technology allows for the generation of synthetic voices that sound remarkably similar to the original voice.

It's used in various applications such as virtual assistants, audio content creation, and personalization of user experiences.

These tools are highly valued in industries where voice plays a crucial role, like entertainment, marketing, and customer service.

They offer capabilities like voice synthesis, modulation, and customization, enabling the creation of unique and realistic voice experiences.

Top AI Voice Cloning Tools:

  • ElevenLabs—Known for its high-quality voice cloning capabilities, offering lifelike and natural-sounding voice replicas.
  • Playht—Provides an array of realistic synthetic voices, widely used for converting text to speech in various applications.
  • Resemble AI—Specializes in creating custom AI voices, allowing for personalized voice experiences in different projects.
  • Murf AI—A versatile tool that offers a range of AI voices suitable for professional-grade voiceovers in videos and presentations.
  • Adobe Podcast—Adobe's venture into voice technology, focusing on enhancing audio experiences in podcast production and other audio-based content.

12. AI Productivity Apps

AI productivity apps are digital tools designed to enhance efficiency and organization in personal and professional tasks.

Utilizing artificial intelligence, these apps streamline complex tasks, automate routine processes, and provide intelligent insights to improve productivity.

These apps are essential for individuals and teams looking to optimize their time management, project coordination, note-taking, and information processing. They adapt to user preferences and work styles, offering personalized solutions to daily challenges.

Top AI Productivity Apps:

  • Taskade—A versatile tool for task management, project tracking, and real-time collaboration, enhanced with AI to streamline workflows.
  • Genei—An innovative app focused on research and reading, using AI to summarize documents and highlight key information.
  • Mem—Aims to revolutionize note-taking and information organization, leveraging AI for smarter and faster note capture and retrieval.
  • Otter—Offers advanced voice transcription and meeting notes, utilizing AI for accurate, real-time speech-to-text conversion.
  • Reclaim—An intelligent scheduling tool that dynamically adapts to priorities and helps in balancing personal and professional commitments.
  • Sembly AI—Offers AI-driven meeting intelligence, capable of capturing, transcribing, and analyzing meeting content for actionable insights.

If there are any specific features or details you'd like me to include or adjust in this overview, please let me know. I'm here to customize it to your precise needs.

13. AI Music Generation

AI music generation involves the use of artificial intelligence to compose and produce music.

These innovative tools cater to a wide range of music production needs, from creating background music for videos to generating unique compositions for artists and producers.

These tools are particularly useful for filmmakers, content creators, musicians, and anyone interested in exploring music creation.

They offer capabilities like automatic composition, style mimicry, and audio separation, enabling users to create high-quality music with minimal musical expertise.

Top AI Music Generators:

  • Mubert—Specializes in creating custom, royalty-free music using AI. It's popular among content creators for its unique compositions and ease of use.
  • Soundraw—An AI music generator that allows users to create original music by setting moods, styles, and instruments, making it versatile for various projects.
  • Lalal AI—Utilizes AI for advanced audio separation and processing, enabling users to extract vocals and instruments from any track.
  • Beatoven AI—Focuses on providing AI-assisted music composition, offering users the ability to create custom tracks tailored to specific requirements.

If there are additional features or specific aspects you'd like to explore or modify in this overview, please let me know. I'm here to adjust it to your precise needs.

14. AI SEO Tools

AI SEO tools are advanced platforms that leverage artificial intelligence to optimize websites for search engines.

These tools are designed to enhance various aspects of SEO, including keyword research, content optimization, link building, and site analysis.

These tools are essential for digital marketers, content creators, and website owners aiming to improve their online visibility and ranking.

They provide insights, automate tasks, and offer recommendations based on AI analysis, making SEO more efficient and effective.

Top AI SEO Tools:

  • SurferSEO —Offers in-depth analysis and optimization recommendations for content, helping users align their web pages with SEO best practices.
  • SEOmatic—A versatile tool that automates SEO tasks, including metadata and structured data generation for improved site indexing and ranking.
  • AIOSEO—Provides comprehensive SEO solutions, from on-page optimization to social media integration and site audits.
  • Scalenut—Focuses on content creation and optimization, using AI to generate SEO-friendly content ideas and structures.

15. AI Presentation Tools

AI presentation tools are innovative software solutions that use artificial intelligence to assist in creating compelling and visually striking presentations.

These tools are designed to simplify the design process, improve content organization, and enhance the overall aesthetic of presentations.

These tools are invaluable for professionals, educators, and anyone needing to create impactful presentations with ease.

They offer features like automatic design adjustments, content suggestions, and data visualization enhancements, all powered by AI to ensure a professional and engaging end product.

Top AI Presentation Tools:

  • Prezi—A presentation platform built around a zoomable canvas rather than linear slides. Its AI handles layout, imagery, and design so you can go from a blank page to a polished deck in seconds. Present alongside your content on video calls with Prezi Video, and track engagement by frame with built-in analytics. Trusted by 160M+ users across 195 countries.
  • Alai—Built for premium slide quality. Alai generates four strong design options per slide and makes refinement easy, manually or with AI, on a responsive canvas that keeps layouts intact.
  • Gamma—Established AI presentation maker that Sspecializes in creating dynamic presentations that adapt to audience interactions.
  • Tome—Known for its ability to turn narratives into interactive, web-based presentations, using AI to enhance storytelling and engagement.
  • BeautifulAI—A tool that focuses on design aesthetics, providing AI-powered assistance to create visually appealing and well-structured slides.
  • Typeset—Offers AI-driven solutions for professional and academic presentations, focusing on content clarity and effective information layout.
  • Presentations AI—A straightforward AI tool that generates full slide decks from a text prompt, but the results tend to feel more generic and less flexible than other tools on this list.

Conclusion

In today's world, AI is becoming an indispensable tool for businesses of all sizes—so don't get left behind!

Many businesses started using AI to optimize their tasks and processes and increase productivity in general.

When I first heard about some of these tools, I was skeptical, but once I gave it a try, I knew I’d never come back to my old way of doing things.

If you ignore AI now, you risk getting left behind!

Now, thanks to AI you can automate many things around your business, from research to copywriting, content creation, SEO optimization, image generation and anything in-between.

My list highlights some of the best AI tools available for businesses as of now in December 2023.

I will be updating this list regularly as new great tools launch nearly every day.
